# Globs the pull-request mutation gate (mutants-pr.yml) does not mutate.
#
# Each file below is either test-only code or exercised only by a wrapper that
# owns a disposable database or broker, so a plain `cargo test` reports its
# mutants as missed.
# Redis contracts that read RULLST_TEST_REDIS_URL are not listed: the gate
# provides that service. Keep this list to such files; everything else is
# tested.

# Generated-project integration suites are too slow to rerun per mutant.
cargo-rullst/**
# The experimental extras moved out of cargo-rullst in 13.0.0-alpha.4 keep
# its lighter-test status (unit and binary tests in the CLI shard).
cargo-rullst-extras/**
# Example applications to copy from, moved in 13.0.0-alpha.4 from the CLI
# blueprints (excluded above with cargo-rullst/**); their own tests run in the
# workspace suite.
examples/erp/**
examples/lms/**
examples/portfolio/**

# Test-only modules included with `#[cfg(test)] #[path = "..."] mod ...;` or
# `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` backed by a `tests/` directory under `src/`.
# cargo-mutants does not see the `cfg(test)` on the parent's declaration and
# would mutate test helpers. (`*_test.rs` is not listed: rullst-orm-macros'
# `sandbox_test.rs` is production code.)
**/*_tests.rs
**/tests.rs
**/tests/**

# PostgreSQL: .github/check-passkey-postgres.py, check-privacy-postgres.py
# and check-mail-postgres.py.
rullst-auth/src/auth/passkey/shared/postgres.rs
rullst-auth/src/auth/passkey/shared/postgres/**
rullst-privacy/src/age_assurance/postgres.rs
rullst-privacy/src/consent/postgres.rs
rullst-mail/src/suppression/postgres/**

# PostgreSQL and MySQL login challenges: .github/check-connect-sql.py.
rullst-connect/src/challenge/sql/postgres.rs
rullst-connect/src/challenge/sql/mysql.rs

# MySQL/MariaDB live matrices in ci.yml.
rullst-ai/src/ai/memory/sql/mysql.rs
rullst-capital/src/quota/sql/mysql.rs

# Authenticated, TLS and restart Redis contracts: .github/check-messaging-redis.py.
rullst-messaging/src/redis_streams/**
